name: Buildbot Self-Hosted CI
free_limit: Open-source Buildbot master, workers and web UI for self-hosted continuous integration, build and test automation; no vendor-imposed software execution or build-minute quota.
watch_out: Run and secure your own Buildbot controller, workers, build storage and integrations; compute, storage and networking may cost money. Buildbot is GPL-2.0 licensed, so distribution must comply with the license.
